name: T02
source:
theorem T02 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.S Scope.Model.detJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2

author: private-a1
name: T04
source:
theorem T04 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  have e := T02 m N M
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hS
  have hS' : m.S ≤ 0 := by omega
  have a : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg (Int.le_of_lt h2) (Int.le_of_lt h3)) (Int.sq_nonneg N)
  have b : 0 ≤ (-m.S) * (N * M) :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (Int.mul_nonneg h5 (Int.le_of_lt h4))
  have hM : 0 < M ^ 2 := by
    have := Int.mul_pos h4 h4
    have h : M ^ 2 = M * M := by grind
    rw [h]; exact this
  have c : 0 < m.detJ * M ^ 2 := Int.mul_pos h1 hM
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S

author: private-a1
name: H01
source:
theorem H01 : ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.hamGain r₁ B C ≤ Scope.hamGain r₂ B C := by
  intro r₁ r₂ B C h1 h2
  unfold Scope.hamGain
  have := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 h2
  omega
statement: ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.hamGain r₁ B C ≤ Scope.hamGain r₂ B C

author: private-a1
name: H03
source:
theorem H03 : ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.Favoured r₁ B C → Scope.Favoured r₂ B C := by
  intro r₁ r₂ B C h1 h2 h3
  have h := H01 r₁ r₂ B C h1 h2
  unfold Scope.Favoured at *
  omega
statement: ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.Favoured r₁ B C → Scope.Favoured r₂ B C

author: private-a1
name: T11
source:
theorem T11 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2 := by
  intro m p s hD hp hP ⟨n, hn, h⟩
  have h2 := T02 m (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p)
  have hMdef : Scope.modeM p = p ^ 2 := rfl
  have hNdef : Scope.modeN s n = (n:Int) ^ 2 * s ^ 2 := rfl
  have hn1 : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) := by omega
  have hn2 : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) ^ 2 := by
    have := Int.mul_le_mul hn1 hn1 (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [show (n:Int)^2 = n*n by grind]
    omega
  have hp2 : 0 < p ^ 2 := by
    rw [show p^2 = p*p by grind]
    exact Int.mul_pos hp hp
  have hs2 : 0 ≤ s ^ 2 := Int.sq_nonneg s
  have hts : 0 ≤ ((n:Int) ^ 2 - 1) * s ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) hs2
  have hPt : 0 ≤ (m.Du * m.Dv) * (((n:Int) ^ 2 - 1) * s ^ 2) := Int.mul_nonneg hP hts
  generalize hN : Scope.modeN s n = N at *
  generalize hM : Scope.modeM p = M at *
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ N := by rw [hNdef]; exact Int.mul_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) hs2
  have hM2 : 0 < M ^ 2 := by
    rw [show M^2 = M*M by grind]
    rw [hMdef]; exact Int.mul_pos hp2 hp2
  have hDM : 0 < m.detJ * M ^ 2 := Int.mul_pos hD hM2
  have hPN : 0 ≤ (m.Du * m.Dv) * N ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg hP (Int.sq_nonneg N)
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by
    rcases Int.lt_or_eq_of_le hN0 with h3 | h3
    · exact h3
    · subst h3
      exfalso
      rw [h2] at h
      have : m.S * 0 * M = 0 := by grind
      omega
  have hlt : (m.Du * m.Dv) * N < m.S * M := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hc
    have hle : m.S * M ≤ (m.Du * m.Dv) * N := by omega
    have := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle hN0
    rw [h2] at h
    grind
  have hNe : N = (n:Int)^2 * s^2 := hNdef
  have hMe : M = p^2 := hMdef
  subst hMe
  have : (m.Du * m.Dv) * N = (m.Du * m.Dv) * s^2 + (m.Du * m.Dv) * (((n:Int) ^ 2 - 1) * s ^ 2) := by
    rw [hNe]; grind
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2
